_finding: This row's own detail says 'Approved: use pl-7 from Tailwind's 4px scale' — 28px. The component renders 22px. Measured, not read from the className. The DOC is the stale side here, not the code: see _derivation.
_derivation: 22px is not an off-scale magic number, it is the panel title row's own geometry. That row is `flex items-center gap-1.5` holding a `size-4` icon then the title: 16px icon + 6px gap = 22px, which is exactly where the title's text begins. Both operands are real tokens already in the markup, so the value is derived from the design system rather than invented.
_measured: With the layout settled (polled until three consecutive reads agreed), the title's text starts at x=1009.00 and the subtitle's text starts at x=1009.00 — 0.00px drift. pl-7/28px would push the subtitle 6px PAST the title it is meant to hang under.
_why_not_28: Origin hardcoded 28px because origin's own title row had different geometry. Adopting 28px here would reproduce origin's number while breaking the alignment that number existed to achieve — the value is only meaningful relative to the row above it.
_settle_warning: A first pass measured the icon at 15.2px and reported a 1.1px misalignment that does not exist. Layout had not finished. Any re-measurement of this row must settle first; a single post-networkidle read is not enough.
